title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and upgrade actions
author: Maya Chen
commits: chore(ci): add consolidated .github/workflows/ci.yml and split jobs for lint/test/release
chore(ci): upgrade actions/setup-node to v3, cache node-modules and pnpm-store; update lockfile handling
fix(tests): reduce e2e flakiness by increasing wait timeout and retrying flaky step
chore(deps): bump eslint, typescript and testing libs in package.json (dev deps)
description:
Consolidates multiple GitHub Actions workflows (lint, test, release) into a single maintainable pipeline and upgrades a handful of Actions and dev dependencies. Motivation: duplicated workflow YAML across repos caused drift, slowed iteration on CI improvements, and increased maintenance burden. This change centralizes common steps, introduces job matrices for node versions, adds stronger cache keys for node modules/pnpm, and upgrades actions/setup-node to v3.

What I changed: consolidated .github workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml with explicit jobs: checkout, setup-node (cache), install, lint, unit-tests, integration-tests, build, and release (manual/conditional). Moved reusable bash wrapper scripts into scripts/ci and a small JS helper into tools/ci/common-steps.js to keep YAML minimal. Upgraded eslint, typescript, and testing libs in package.json devDependencies and updated pnpm-lock.yaml. Addressed flaky e2e test by increasing default timeouts and adding a retry wrapper for the specific step.

Why this is safe: job boundaries remain the same semantics (lint -> tests -> build -> release) and release job remains gated behind an approval/trigger for protected branches. Tests were run in CI and locally; added a conservatively scoped cache key to avoid incorrect cache hits. No runtime production code changes included.

Related Linear: ENG-1284 (CI consolidation), ENG-2145 (stabilize e2e tests).
review_comments: Samir Rao (reviewer): Nice consolidation. Can we avoid running the full install step for lint-only changes by adding a conditional path? Suggest adding 'if: contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip-install]')' or better: job-level conditional based on changed files.
Maya Chen (author): Good call, added a minimal path that uses pnpm -w --filter to install only devtools for lint in 2nd commit; kept full install for test/build jobs.

Elena Voss (reviewer): Tests look good. One nit: prefer using actions/cache with restore-keys including node-version and OS to avoid cross-node cache pollution. Also please pin actions/checkout to v3 explicitly.
Maya Chen (author): Updated cache restore-keys and pinned actions/checkout@v3. Verified cache hit behavior in two runs.
Tomás García (reviewer): Approving after seeing rerun of flaky unit-tests passed. Please squash on merge and include a short release note.
